svg.aria-label: You settle the work with the Supervisor, which writes the concept and your standing orders. The Supervisor opens a lane; its Lead splits it into tasks, one Peer each on its own branch, with the gate at every hand-back; the Lead accepts, reworks or cuts, and accepted work goes through a merge queue. Asks go up to the Supervisor, which puts what only you can decide on your question queue. The Lead reports the lane ready, the Supervisor lands it, and the desk merges your base in, runs the gate and waits for your approval only on paths you asked to see. You read the report and push; the watch pages you for what cannot be undone.

svg.text: How a piece of work goes
Every step is a seat's own call. The desk records it, carries the letter, and brings you in where it must.
